title: Quantile Forensics dashboard + regression watcher for routes/models/regions
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a ‘Quantile Forensics’ telemetry surface and an automated regression watcher that tracks p95/p99 latency slices per API route, model variant, and region. This ticket covers schema changes, telemetry enrichment, pipeline transforms, a lightweight store for quantile time-series, and a dashboard + alerting/playbook for on-call to triage percentile regressions. The goal is to enable fast root-cause (workload vs infra vs model) and reduce MTTI for tail spikes across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments.
acceptance_criteria: Telemetry emits p50/p95/p99 and sample-count for each (route, model_variant, region, deployment_tier) slice at 1m resolution
Dashboard with filterable matrix (routes x models x regions) showing baseline, current percentiles, delta %, sparkline and recent anomalous windows
Automated regression watcher creates incidents when p99 increases > 40% vs 7-day baseline AND absolute p99 exceeds configured threshold for the route
On-call runbook links to example failed request traces, recent synthetic workload playback, and suggested rollback or fallback model actions
End-to-end tests in inferbench show the metric surfaces populate under synthetic stress for at least three routes and two models
implementation_plan: Schema: add quantile envelope fields to request telemetry: q50_ms, q95_ms, q99_ms, sample_count, window_start_iso; tag keys: route, model_variant, region, customer_tier
Instrumentation: update serving runtime batching emitter to emit quantiles per 1m window; include synthetic-marker boolean for playback requests

Pipeline: add a streaming transform stage to aggregate percentiles by slice and write to quantile-store (ClickHouse / Timescale alternative evaluation); also write rollup snapshots to long-term warehouse for historical baselines
Anomaly detector: implement regression watcher using robust ratio test (median-of-windows) with hysteresis and cooldown to avoid flapping; surface alerts to PagerDuty and Console alert inbox
Dashboard: create a matrix explorer UI in Console with bulk filters, explainers, and export links to CSV and to playback job presets
Load harness changes: inferbench should be able to label runs with route/model/region and mark runs as synthetic; add playback presets for 4 canonical routes
Testing: unit tests for pipeline transforms, integration test validating dashboard end-to-end using synthetic load in staging
metrics_schema_notes: Primary metric names: telemetry.quantiles.q50_ms, telemetry.quantiles.q95_ms, telemetry.quantiles.q99_ms
Labels: route (string), model_variant (string), region (string), deployment_tier (hosted|dedicated|private), synthetic_marker (bool), window_start (ISO)
Retention: 1m resolution raw for 30d in quantile-store, daily rollups kept for 1y in warehouse
Cardinality guardrails: limit model_variant cardinality by canonicalizing variant tags and dropping unknown variants after sampling threshold
Backfill plan: compute baseline from existing trace+raw latency aggregates where available for initial week-on-week comparisons
dashboard_notes: Matrix view should allow pinning specific slices and creating watchlists
Each cell shows current p95, p99, percent-change vs baseline, and a mini sparkline for last 24h
Details pane shows sampled raw requests (up to 200) with links to full traces, config to re-run inferbench with identical seed
Support exporting a JSON watchlist to share with SRE/PMs and attach to incident reports
Performance: lazy-load slice data and paginate to avoid huge queries on high-cardinality orgs
alerting_rules: Rule: p99 > route_threshold_ms AND p99 / baseline_p99_7d >= 1.4 -> create incident
Cooldown: suppress repeated alerts for same slice for 30m after incident creation
Escalation: P1 if customer_impact=high or >10% of requests in last 5m are above service-level threshold
Mitigation autopilot hook: when alert fires attempt automatic fallback to lower-latency model_variant if one exists and rollback is enabled
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (staging): enable telemetry enrichment + pipeline transform for all routes in staging; run inferbench synthetic playback for 72h
Phase 2 (canary): enable quantile-store for 10% of production routes (low-risk ones) and validate dashboard accuracy vs traces
Phase 3 (wide): enable for all routes and models; start watcher with conservative thresholds for 48h, then tighten
Phase 4 (hardening): incorporate feedback, tune cardinality controls, and roll long-term retention to warehouse
risks_and_mitigations: High cardinality blowup: mitigate with canonicalization and sampling along with a hard cap and telemetry drop policy
False positives due to short-lived infra blips: use hysteresis, cooldown, and require both relative and absolute threshold to fire
Storage cost increase: keep 1m resolution in hot store for 30d only and use daily rollups thereafter
Dashboard performance under large orgs: implement server-side pagination and pre-computed rollups for common queries
